tools.name: preview_blueprint_json
tools.description: Returns a paginated slice of the generated WordPress Playground blueprint JSON along with total step count and byte length. Use when inspecting or validating the generated JSON before exporting, launching, or sharing.

offset.description: Character offset in the formatted blueprint JSON to start reading from (defaults to 0).

limit.description: Maximum JSON characters to return in this slice (defaults to 1000).

tools.name: export_blueprint_json
tools.description: Triggers a browser download of the current blueprint as a formatted JSON file. Use when the user asks to download or export their blueprint.json locally.

tools.name: launch_playground
tools.description: Opens the generated blueprint in WordPress Playground in a new browser tab. Use when the user asks to launch, test, or run their configured blueprint live.

tools.name: initiate_save_blueprint
tools.description: Opens the Save Blueprint dialog pre-filled with optional title, description, and visibility so the user can review and confirm saving to the gallery. Use when the user wants to save or publish their blueprint.

title.description: Optional title to pre-fill in the Save Blueprint dialog (defaults to current site title).

description.description: Optional summary describing what the blueprint includes.

is_public.description: Whether to pre-toggle Share Publicly in the gallery dialog (user confirms before saving).

tools.name: initiate_share_playground
tools.description: Opens the Share Playground dialog pre-filled with the current blueprint URL and optional title or description so the user can review and create a short link. Use when the user wants a shareable Playground link.

title.description: Optional title to pre-fill for the shared Playground link.

description.description: Optional description to pre-fill for the shared Playground link.
